title: Koszul dual of a Koszul-regular immersion
statement: Let Y be a Noetherian scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let i:Z\to Y be a Koszul-regular closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence]. Let C_i be its conormal sheaf [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf, def-pc-module-pullback], let N_i:=\operatorname{SheafHom}_{\mathcal O_Z}(C_i,\mathcal O_Z) be its normal sheaf [def-pur-sheaf-hom], and let r be the locally constant rank of C_i. If a is the right adjoint of Ri_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y) [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-direct-image], then there is a canonical isomorphism \bigwedge^r N_i[-r]\cong a(\mathcal O_Y) in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z).

proof.text: A closed immersion is finite by [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-finite]. Z is Noetherian, being a closed subscheme of the Noetherian scheme Y, so i is a finite morphism of Noetherian schemes and \mathcal O_Y lies in D^+_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y). Apply finite Grothendieck duality [lem-sc-finite-duality-derived-hom] to i and K=\mathcal O_Y. Since a is the right adjoint of Ri_* on quasi-coherent complexes, this gives a canonical isomorphism Ri_*a(\mathcal O_Y)\simeq R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Y}(i_*\mathcal O_Z,\mathcal O_Y).

The Koszul-regular Ext calculation [lem-sc-koszul-regular-immersion-derived-hom], applied with the locally constant rank r of C_i, identifies the right-hand side with Ri_*\bigl(\bigwedge^r N_i[-r]\bigr). The hypotheses match by the Koszul-regular immersion and rank assumptions.

Because i is affine, the equivalence [lem-sc-finite-affine-derived-equivalence] identifies D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z) with D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(i_*\mathcal O_Z), and its restriction functor is Ri_*. The module-compatible isomorphism between Ri_*a(\mathcal O_Y) and Ri_*\bigl(\bigwedge^rN_i[-r]\bigr) therefore descends uniquely under this equivalence to \bigwedge^rN_i[-r]\cong a(\mathcal O_Y) in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Z).
